summarization: This smartphone UI screen is from an application that has a "Favourites" section. The screen is divided into two tabs: "ADS" and "SEARCHES." The "SEARCHES" tab is currently selected. The main content of the screen indicates that there are no saved searches yet. It prompts the user to click on the heart icon to save a search. The screen also features a simple illustration of a laptop and a smartphone, both displaying a star, symbolizing the favorites or saved items. The top of the screen has a navigation menu icon (three horizontal lines) and the title "Favourites." The status bar at the top shows various system icons and the time.
